Personal Intelligence from Gemini — AI help just for you

# Personal Intelligence

## Help that’s made for you

Get highly personal help with everything from vacation ideas to project plans, and more. Gemini connects the dots across your Google apps—like Gmail, Photos, Search, and YouTube—and your chat history preferences to provide suggestions tailored to your world.

- Try Personal Intelligence

## Speaks fluent you

## Tailored help is here

Let Gemini connect the dots across your Google apps—like Gmail, Photos, Search, and YouTube—and make Gemini uniquely helpful for you. You’re in control. You decide which apps to connect to and can manage your personalization settings at any time.

Now rolling out to users for free in the U.S.

## Narrow your options

Not sure about a big purchase? Gemini can research different products and break down the choices that fit your specific needs.

## Share your preferences to get even more specific

Ask Gemini to remember your interests and preferences like work, hobbies, and life goals for more helpful, relevant responses.

## Find new favorites

Ask Gemini to find something you won’t want to put down, with book recommendations tailored to your reading history and what you like.

## Seamless conversations, every time

Ask Gemini to consider your past chats to craft its responses. Easily pick up where you left off or have it summarize a previous topic. You can view or delete any chats you’ve had with Gemini.

## Discover hidden gems

Build a trip that’s fine-tuned to you. Gemini recommends spots based on your tastes and past picks, helping you find new favorites from local eats to new neighborhoods to explore.

## Your privacy, your control

We're committed to transparency and giving you control.

### Opt in and out as you please

Personal Intelligence experiences are optional. You can choose which Google apps to connect, manage how your past chats are used, and set your own instructions.

### Data, managed

View your Google activity, access your Personal Intelligence in Gemini settings, and review your past Gemini chat history.

### Transparency is our priority

Gemini will try to reference or explain the information it used from your connected sources so you can verify it. If it doesn’t, you can ask it for more information.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Personal Intelligence in Gemini and how does it work?

With Personal Intelligence, Gemini provides more relevant and personalized responses by analyzing your prompt alongside your context. It determines if your custom instructions, past chats, or information from your connected Google apps could be helpful in formulating an answer. This additional context ensures that the information you receive is tailored to your specific interests and needs.

Who can use Personal Intelligence and where is it available?

Personal Intelligence is currently rolling out as a beta to eligible users in the United States.

Requirements: You must be over the age of 18. This beta feature is available for personal Google accounts and not for Workspace business, enterprise or education users.

Platforms: Once enabled, it works across Web, Android, and iOS.

Models: It works with all models currently available in the Gemini model picker.

Which Google apps can connect to Personal Intelligence?

Personal Intelligence currently connects with Google apps like Gmail, Photos, Search, and Youtube. In the coming months, and with your permission, Gemini will be able to draw context from even more of your Google apps and services.

Sequences shortened. Check responses. Compatibility and availability varies. Available to users 18+.

NextRead AI

# About NextRead AI

The most advanced AI-powered book discovery platform that understands your mood, learns from your preferences, and delivers surprisingly accurate recommendations through cutting-edge machine learning technology.

Advanced AI Engine

Mobile-First Design

Personalized Learning

### 📱 Experience NextRead AI on Your iPhone & iPad

Get the full NextRead AI experience with our beautifully designed mobile app, featuring intuitive touch controls and seamless book discovery.

### What Makes NextRead AI Different?

NextRead AI represents the next generation of book discovery, combining advanced AI technology with deep understanding of reader psychology. Unlike traditional platforms that rely on simple rating matches or genre filtering, our system understands the emotional nuance behind what you're truly seeking.

When you tell us you're “feeling nostalgic,” need “something uplifting for a rainy day,” or want to “escape reality,” our AI comprehends these feelings and suggests books that match your current emotional state and reading desires.

#### Personalized Learning

Our AI learns from your ratings, reviews, and reading reflections to continuously improve recommendations. The more you interact, the more accurate our suggestions become.

#### Modern Experience

Built with the latest web technologies for a fast, responsive experience across all devices. Beautiful, intuitive design that makes book discovery a joy, not a chore.

#### Reflection System

Write reflections about books you've read to help our AI understand your deeper preferences. Your thoughts become part of the recommendation engine, creating truly personalized suggestions.

#### Privacy-First

Your reading data stays yours. We don't sell data to third parties, show advertisements, or track you across the web. Pure focus on helping you discover great books.

🎯 Why Choose NextRead AI Over Alternatives?

- • Goodreads: Modern UI, AI-powered vs. basic collaborative filtering
- • StoryGraph: Advanced AI reranking vs. simple mood tags
- • Amazon: Unbiased recommendations vs. purchase-driven suggestions
- • Book blogs: Instant AI analysis vs. waiting for human reviews

### Our Advanced AI Recommendation Engine

NextRead AI uses a sophisticated hybrid approach that combines multiple AI technologies to deliver the most accurate recommendations possible:

#### 1. Semantic Understanding

OpenAI's advanced language models analyze your request to understand the emotional, thematic, and contextual elements you're seeking.

#### 2. Vector Similarity Search

Our pgvector-powered database searches through embeddings of thousands of books to find semantic matches beyond simple keyword matching.

#### 3. GPT-4 Reranking

Results are reranked using your personal reading history, ratings, and reflections to ensure the most relevant suggestions appear first.

#### Latest Enhancements (2025)

##### Smart Personalization System

Our AI now learns from your ratings, feedback, and reading reflections to build a comprehensive understanding of your preferences.

##### Drag & Drop Shelf Organization

Effortlessly reorganize your bookshelves by dragging and dropping them into your preferred order on both desktop and mobile devices.

##### Enhanced Mobile Experience

Completely redesigned mobile interface with intuitive touch controls, optimized layouts, and seamless book management including touch-friendly drag interactions.

##### Book Reflection System

Write detailed reflections about books you've read to help our AI understand your deeper preferences and improve recommendations.

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What's included with NextRead AI?

NextRead AI offers a freemium model. The Discover screen with basic AI recommendations is free to use. For unlimited access to all features including personalized shelves, detailed book analysis, mood-based discovery, and advanced AI recommendations, we offer a premium subscription at $4.99/month.

Achriom – AI Librarian for Your Books, Movies, Music & Shows

# There's a pattern in what you love

Achriom is a personal media library and AI librarian that tracks your books, movies, music, shows, and anime. It finds the patterns that connect what you love.

Start free See how it works ↓

Free to start. No credit card required.

## Achriom is AI-native media tracking.

A personal librarian for your books, movies, music, shows, and anime. One that knows your taste and can talk about it.

1 / 8

## How it works

01

### Add your collection

Import from Letterboxd, Goodreads, or Apple Music. Scan a shelf with your camera. Or just ask the librarian to add anything.

02

### Achriom learns your taste

The themes that recur. The moods you return to. The connections you haven't named yet.

03

### Start a conversation

Find patterns across your collection. Watch director interviews. Search inside your books. Discover what to read or watch next.

The conversation

## Ask anything about your collection

Start a conversation with something that knows your collection.

"What do my 5-star ratings have in common?"

→ Finds through-lines across everything you've loved and shows patterns you hadn't noticed

"I need something slow and quiet tonight."

→ Pulls from your library based on mood and taste, not just genre tags

"Find the passage in Dune about the water."

→ Searches semantically inside your uploaded EPUBs

"I've been scrolling Netflix for 20 minutes."

→ Cuts through decision paralysis with a pick from your own library

## Who it's for

### The Intentional One

You don't just watch, read, or listen. You think about why certain things resonate. You want to understand your own taste.

### The Archivist

You've built a library over years. Hundreds of items across formats. You own things in a streaming world.

### The Deep Diver

You read reviews, watch video essays, listen to podcasts about music you already own. You want to go deeper.

### The Pattern Seeker

You sense that your favorite movies and favorite books share something. You want to articulate what connects them.

## Features

### Books

Import from Goodreads. Upload EPUBs and search inside them. "Find where Didion talks about self-respect."

### Movies

Import from Letterboxd. Watch trailers and director interviews embedded in our conversation.

### Albums

Import from Apple Music. Explore your listening history and discover patterns in what you play.

### Shows

Track where you are season-by-season. Get recommendations based on your favorite episodes.

### Anime

Track series and films. Get recommendations that match your taste across both anime and live-action.

Plus

- Scan shelves with your camera
- AI summaries and theme analysis
- Cross-media connections
- Available anywhere via web browser
